newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine May inflation flat at 0.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine May inflation flat at 0.8 pct.

text.p: Ukraine's May inflation rate stayed flat at 0.8 percent, the Statistics Ministry said on Wednesday.
UKRAINE CONSUMER PRICES May 97 April 97 May 96
Prices have risen 5.2 percent so far this year, compared to a rise of 24.8 percent for the same period last year.
The 1997 budget, awaiting final approval, has forecast inflation of 24.8 percent this year after 39.7 percent in 1996.
But Prime Minister Pavlo Lazarenko has said annual inflation could be 15 to 16 percent this year.
He also said Ukraine would delay charging citizens full prices for gas, electricity and communal services until wage arrears amounting to five billion hryvnias ($2.7 billion) is paid.
Ukrainians currently pay 80 percent of the cost of energy and housing.
